fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (contradiction on watchdog-transient-failure): The model's daemon-resume-once (01M61R7MP3HGEB60GJV4M3CWQA) says the daemon leaves alone every failed run (the inbox lists it as failed) and never resumes a run interrupted again after its one resume. The watchdog leaves watchdog-transient-failure, watchdog-ci-rerun, watchdog-green-pr-unmerged, watchdog-stuck-requests and watchdog-stalled-step resume failed or re-stalled runs with --retry. The plan doesn't amend or narrow daemon-resume-once, so after it lands the two capabilities contradict each other. daemon-resume-once should say failed and given-up runs are left to the watchdog's policy. The critic confirmed it: daemon-resume-once (01M61R7MP3HGEB60GJV4M3CWQA, unchanged in the what-if view of this change set) says the daemon leaves alone every failed run and any run interrupted again after its one resume. watchdog-transient-failure resumes failed runs with --retry, and the other watchdog leaves resume given-up runs. The plan writes no op on daemon-resume-once and rhiza overlaps shows nothing, so once it lands the two capabilities contradict each other. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f2 (contradiction on watchdog-plan-interview): The Source's summary of the arbiter's answer puts the defaults 'under [rhiza.daemon.watchdog] in rhiza.toml' with 'file_bugs on', and mentions only machine settings. The Decision watchdog-scope-and-defaults it backs, and watchdog-policy, instead use flat full-key strings rhiza.daemon.watchdog.* under [daemon], a camelCase fileBugs key, and project keys rhiza.project.watchdog.* in git config that override the machine keys. The provenance record and the decision disagree on where the policy lives and what its keys are called. The critic confirmed it: The watchdog-plan-interview summary says the defaults live 'under [rhiza.daemon.watchdog] in rhiza.toml' with 'file_bugs on' and mentions no project keys. watchdog-policy states flat rhiza.daemon.watchdog.* keys under [daemon], a camelCase fileBugs key, and rhiza.project.watchdog.* project keys in git config. The Source behind the decision misstates its layout and key names. How should it be settled?
